title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Claims Manual: Coverage Determination
content:
One coverage determination is issued per rider service request under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons; whether one is already on file for the request is read from the request's handling history.

## Conditions of cover

A rider failure is covered only when every condition below holds. Otherwise it is not covered, and the determination gives the first failing reason in this order:

| Order | Reason when the condition fails | Condition that must hold |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rider not in force | The rider was active, and its base contract in force for service, on the request date. |
| 2 | Waiting period | The failure was first reported on or after the rider's coverage effective date. |
| 3 | Component not covered | The component is among the rider's covered components and not among its excluded components. For the Guest Unit Rider, the item is one the base tier covers and the guest unit is no larger than the rider's maximum guest unit living area. For the Limited Roof Leak Rider, the roof type is one the rider accepts, and the leak is over an occupied living area where the rider covers only such leaks. |
| 4 | Pre-existing condition | No condition existing before the rider's coverage effective date is covered; this includes a pool or spa not in operating condition when the rider was added, and a roof leak that existed when the roof condition was attested. |
| 5 | Misuse or external damage | Misuse, freezing, chemical damage, weather and other external causes are never covered. |
| 6 | Cap exhausted | The remaining term benefit under the rider's benefit authorization rules is above zero. |

## Applying the order

Only the first failing reason is given, even when several conditions fail.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A pool heater failure on a Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider is first reported before the rider's coverage effective date, and the heater was also damaged by freezing. Condition 2 is the first to fail, so the reason given is waiting period.
- A roof leak on a Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider is over a detached storage area rather than an occupied living area. Conditions 1 and 2 hold; condition 3 fails, so the reason given is component not covered.
- A Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider request concerns a guest unit stated at 800 square feet. Condition 3 fails, since the guest unit is larger than 750 square feet.
- Every condition from 1 to 5 holds but the rider has no term benefit remaining: the reason given is cap exhausted.
